item.title: Self-Hosted DNS Blocklist Management: Pi-hole vs AdGuard Home vs Technitium DNS Server
item.description: DNS-based content filtering is one of the most effective ways to block ads, trackers, malware domains, and unwanted content across your entire network. By maintaining and curating DNS blocklists, you control exactly what gets filtered without relying on third-party services. This guide compares three popular self-hosted DNS blocklist management platforms: Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, and Technitium DNS Server.
